statistic: reject_rank2_cf = Chen-Fang (2019) composite-null rank test, H0: rank(Delta)<=2
which_test_reason: their formulation is exactly H0: rank<=r and their regularity conditions hold here (sqrt(n)-asymptotics for a covariance difference of iid rows, consistent nonparametric bootstrap). Leung-Sturma (arXiv 2401.02112) was not needed.
citation: Chen, Q. and Z. Fang (2019), Improved inference on the rank of a matrix, Quantitative Economics 10(4) 1787-1824, arXiv:1812.02337. Implementation guide Steps 1-5, equations (9), (10), (11).
status: STOPPED AFTER GATE 1 for a decision, per handoff section 4. Gate 2 NOT run. Phase B still refusing.

acceptance.note: CF peaks at 0.040 then falls; it does not climb. Old rule climbs 5x and through alpha.

gate0.reading: every cell is BELOW [0.019,0.081], none above. The handoff's stop condition is ABOVE (anti-conservative bootstrap); it also states a correct composite-null test is exact or conservative at rank 0, which is what was observed.

gate1.diagnosis: CF holds its level in the INTERIOR of H0(2) (true rank <= 1): 0.000 hard-on-source, 0.025 soft. It over-rejects only at the BOUNDARY (true rank exactly 2): 0.125. Two contributors: the tuning parameter kappa under-estimates r_hat (reject 0.182 when r_hat=1 vs 0.094 when r_hat=2), and a residual boundary excess remains even when r_hat is correct. Chen-Fang themselves note kappa is a tuning parameter and recommend the tuning-free sequential KP-based estimator instead.

soft_power_curve.verdict: power problem that n fixes, not a structural inability
